description: Creates (or returns) the WakeTrades trading key for this account and returns the approveAgent action and the EIP-712 typedData to sign with the wallet. Hyperliquid refuses keys on an account without a deposit. Before signing, check that typedData's primaryType is HyperliquidTransaction:ApproveAgent; never sign a Withdraw.
name: prepare_trading_key
title: Prepare the trading key approval
